title: When does each coast get its peak rain?
description: The rainfall graphs of Udupi, Rameswaram and Puri are read for their peak months, and each city is placed on the west or the east coast. The video breaks Keeko's doubt that two cities on the same coast must peak together.
teaching_notes: One idea: read the peak months from each city's own line, and then place the city on the coast. Watch for students who think the coast alone fixes the rainy months.

source: Name the peak months for Udupi, Rameswaram and Puri and say
video_script.why: The child knows how a monthly average is made but has not yet read where the peak of each rainfall line falls, or linked it to a coast.
video_script.substitution: Find the highest months on each city's line, then place the city on the west or the east coast of the map.
video_script.anchor: the book's rainfall graphs of Udupi, Rameswaram and Puri, with the cities marked on a map of India
video_script.wrong_answer: Puri peaks from October to December like Rameswaram
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks two cities on the same coast must have the same peak months, and does not read Puri's own line.
video_script.payoff_line: puri peaks from july to september and lies on the east coast

final_answer.value: Udupi June to August (west); Rameswaram October to December (east); Puri July to September (east)
final_answer.spoken: Udupi peaks from June to August on the west coast, Rameswaram from October to December on the east coast, and Puri from July to September on the east coast

never_show: Puri peaks from October to December
maths_rules: Udupi is on the west coast; its peak rainfall is in June to August
Rameswaram is on the east coast; most of its rain falls in October to December
Puri is on the east coast; its peak rainfall is in July to September
January to March are dry months for all the cities
slip: the coast does not fix the peak months; each line must be read
video_script.design: One idea: read the peak from each line, then place the city on the coast. The wrong idea is that one coast means one peak. A small map of India stays beside the graph; the cities are marked in turn.
